description: Elemental crustal abundance, price and toxicity class for te.evaluate screening scores (phase8.md §4). Values are approximate screening inputs, not procurement data.

sources.abundance_ppm: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 97th ed. (2016), sec. 14, 'Abundance of Elements in the Earth's Crust and in the Sea' (continental crust, mg/kg), as tabulated in Wikipedia 'Abundance of elements in Earth's crust' (CRC column). One source for every element.
sources.price_usd_per_kg: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2025 (https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2025/mcs2025.pdf), Salient Statistics, 2024 estimates, converted to USD/kg (1 lb = 0.453592 kg, 1 troy oz = 31.1035 g). Where USGS has no metal price: Wikipedia 'Prices of chemical elements' with its cited source and year. Oxide/concentrate prices converted to contained element are marked uncertain (lower than metal prices).
sources.toxicity: Class 0 low, 1 moderate, 2 high, from EU CLP (EC 1272/2008) Annex VI harmonised classifications of the element or its common compounds, IARC Monograph groups and EU RoHS (2011/65/EU). Assigned from these listings without per-element re-verification; judgement calls marked uncertain.

Li.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: battery-grade Li2CO3 $14,000/t (2024e), per kg contained Li (18.8 %); Li metal ~$81-86/kg (Wikipedia, SMM 2020)
Li.toxicity_note: Li salts Acute Tox. 4; ECHA RAC (2021) proposed Repr. 1A for Li carbonate/chloride/hydroxide

Mg.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: magnesium metal, US spot Western, $3.50/lb (2024e)

Al.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: ingot, US market spot, 130 c/lb (2024e)

Si.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: silicon metal, 180 c/lb Si (2024e)

Sc.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: Sc2O3 99.99 % $1,200/kg oxide (2024e), per kg contained Sc (65.2 %); metal much higher

V.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: V2O5 $5.45/lb (2024e), per kg contained V (56 %); V metal ~$357-385/kg (Wikipedia, SMM 2020)
V.toxicity_note: V2O5 harmonised Muta. 2, Repr. 2, STOT RE 1; IARC 2B; metal low hazard

Cr.toxicity_note: metal/Cr(III) low hazard; Cr(VI) IARC 1, Carc. 1B, RoHS-restricted

Mn.price_note: Wikipedia 'Prices of chemical elements' (BGR, 2019 avg.), electrolytic Mn 99.7 %; USGS gives ore only

Fe.price_note: Wikipedia 'Prices of chemical elements' (SMM 2020): pig iron; USGS MCS gives scrap/ore only

Co.toxicity_note: Co metal harmonised Carc. 1B, Muta. 2, Repr. 1B, sensitiser (ATP 2020); IARC 2A (2022)

Ni.toxicity_note: Ni metal Carc. 2, Skin Sens. 1; Ni compounds Carc. 1A / IARC 1

Cu.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: LME grade A cash 420 c/lb (2024e)

Ga.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: high-purity Ga import unit value $500/kg (2024e); ~$1,530/kg in Aug 2026 after export controls (Wikipedia/Stockatomics)
Ga.toxicity_note: no carcinogenicity for the metal (GaAs hazard is from As)

Ge.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: germanium metal $2,100/kg (2024e); ~$4,860/kg in Aug 2026 (Wikipedia/Stockatomics)

Zr.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: zirconium sponge, ex-works China, $25/kg (2024e)

Nb.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: ferroniobium unit value $26/kg (2024e; ~65 % Nb); Nb metal ~$61-86/kg (Wikipedia, SMM 2020)

Mo.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: $47/kg Mo, molybdic oxide basis (2024e)

Pd.toxicity_note: metal low hazard; salts are sensitisers

Cd.toxicity_note: Carc. 1B, Muta. 2, Repr. 2, STOT RE 1; IARC 1; RoHS-restricted

In.toxicity_note: InP IARC 2A; indium-compound inhalation lung disease

Sb.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: metal $9.50/lb (2024e; prices spiked in 2024)

Te.toxicity_note: Te compounds acutely toxic; element classification not verified

La.price_note: Wikipedia 'Prices of chemical elements' (SMM Feb 2020): La metal 99 %; USGS gives La2O3 ~ $1/kg

Ta.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: tantalite $170/kg Ta2O5 content (2024e), per kg contained Ta (81.9 %); metal ~$300/kg (Wikipedia, ISE 2019)

W.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: concentrate $250/mtu WO3 (2024e), per kg contained W (79.3 %)
W.toxicity_note: no harmonised classification for the metal

Os.price_note: Wikipedia 'Prices of chemical elements' (Element Sales, 2025); not priced by USGS
Os.toxicity_note: OsO4 (forms from fine metal in air) very toxic

Pb.price_note: USGS MCS 2025: North American refined 110 c/lb (2024e)
